name: Night Light (sunsetr)
author: Mark
description: Night light indicator and control for sunsetr, driven by its event socket instead of hyprsunset. Left-click opens an info popup with an Auto/Day/Night switch, right-click toggles forced day/night, middle-click refreshes. Icon color runs cool-to-warm with the live color temperature; opacity tracks gamma.

barWidget.description: Live color/opacity readout of sunsetr's current temperature and gamma, with toggle and preset control.

schema.label: Day temperature (K)
schema.description: Cool end of the color range. Match your sunsetr.toml day_temp.

schema.label: Night temperature (K)
schema.description: Warm end of the color range. Match your sunsetr.toml night_temp.

schema.label: Force-day preset name
schema.description: sunsetr preset applied when forcing day. Created automatically on first use if missing.

schema.label: Force-night preset name
schema.description: sunsetr preset applied when forcing night. Created automatically on first use if missing.

schema.label: Force fade duration (s)
schema.description: How long forcing day/night fades in, via the preset's own startup_duration. Only applies the first time the preset is created; edit the generated .toml directly to change it afterward.

schema.label: Look up place names online
schema.description: Whether your exact configured latitude/longitude may be sent to BigDataCloud's free reverse-geocoding API to resolve a place name. Off by default, and normally set from the popup's own consent prompt rather than here. Place names that came from the location search box need no lookup and are shown regardless.
